notes.title: Hello Sunshine coming to Tokyo Game Show
notes.content:
Say "Hello" to "Sunshine" at Tokyo Game Show next week![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537926/c7bd51fe3398f1f3bbd11ebd2032618d80f82668.png"]
On September 25, Hello Sunshine is making its first public appearance in Tokyo, where players will have an opportunity to play a demo of our upcoming mystery survival RPG — solo and co-op.

The Hello Sunshine booth is located at Makuhari Messe, Main Hall 5, booth 05-N08 — in collaboration with the Norwegian Film Institute and several amazing Norwegian games.

After a very long radio silence, we're finally ready to share a (small) piece of the world we’re building — and we can’t wait to see what you think.

If you're heading to TGS, please come find us and be among the first in the world to play Hello Sunshine!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537926/83ca2412031ce4ffda96197c508c7f608b51a683.png"]



If Japan isn’t in your travel plans, don’t worry! There’s plenty more Hello Sunshine news on the horizon. Follow along on Steam, and join our Discord for exclusive updates.

We hope to see you there!

Team Red Thread

P.S. Make sure to wishlist if you haven’t already!
